edges.reason: _botProtection constructor parameter flows into the BotProtected constructor.
Constructor writes the parameter into the botProtection state variable.
msg.sender is read in the BCUG constructor to initialise owner.
Constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
Constructor invokes pairFor to derive uniPair.
pairFor computes the local pair address.
pairFor return value is assigned to uniPair.
Constructor grants infinite allowances in the allowance mapping.
msg.sender drives the allowance authorization branch in transferFrom.
_from parameter used as the debited account in transferFrom.
_to parameter used as the credited account in transferFrom.
_value parameter used for all balance and allowance updates.
allowance mapping is read and decremented in transferFrom.
balanceOf mapping is read and mutated in transferFrom.
transferFrom mutates balances and allowance with unchecked -= and +=.
Unchecked arithmetic writes the balanceOf mapping.
Unchecked arithmetic writes the allowance mapping.
The external call in checkBots executes before the transferFrom body, allowing reentrancy into token logic.
botProtection is an externally supplied contract that the low-level call targets.
The checkBots modifier performs the low-level external call.
checkBots modifier guards the transferFrom function.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom.
_to parameter flows through BCUG.transfer.
_value parameter flows through BCUG.transfer.
msg.sender is the owner key written in approve.
_spender parameter key written in approve.
_value parameter written in approve.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in delegate.
Owner-controlled delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall.
Delegatecall target address comes from parameter a.
Delegatecall payload comes from parameter b.
list is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in list.
block.timestamp is used to build the router deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp + 600 is passed as the deadline of addLiquidityETH.
list performs the external payable addLiquidityETH call.
uniRouter instance is the receiver of the addLiquidityETH call.
list rewrites balances from unbounded inputs without SafeMath.
Arbitrary balance assignments write the balanceOf mapping.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 arithmetic determines the owner balance.
_numList directly sets the contract balance with no upper bound.
_tos array elements receive arbitrary balances.
_amounts array elements are assigned to balances.
Loop counter iterates over the _tos/_amounts arrays in list.
tokenA parameter is ordered inside pairFor.
tokenB parameter is ordered inside pairFor.
pairFor assigns the ordered token0 local.
pairFor assigns the ordered token1 local.
notABot captures the boolean success of the bot-protection call and gates execution.
isNotBot captures the unused bytes return data of the bot-protection call.
ERC20.transfer calls the internal _transfer.
_transfer mutates _balances using SafeMath.
ERC20.transferFrom calls the internal _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom calls the internal _approve.
ERC20.approve calls the internal _approve.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_mint increases _totalSupply with SafeMath addition.
_burn decreases _totalSupply with SafeMath subtraction.
_mint credits the _balances mapping.
_burn debits the _balances mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: _botProtection is a constructor parameter consumed directly by BotProtected.constructor.
_to is a parameter of BCUG.transfer and has no meaning outside it.
_value is a parameter of BCUG.transfer and has no meaning outside it.
_from is a parameter of BCUG.transferFrom and drives the balance debit.
_spender is a parameter of BCUG.approve used as the allowance key.
a is the delegatecall target parameter, directly bound to the unsafe delegatecall operation.
b is the delegatecall payload parameter, directly bound to the unsafe delegatecall operation.
_numList is the unbounded input feeding the unchecked balance assignment in list.
_tos is the recipient array of BCUG.list used directly in the balance loop.
_amounts is the amount array of BCUG.list used directly in the balance loop.
tokenA is a parameter of pairFor used only for address ordering.
tokenB is a parameter of pairFor used only for address ordering.
token0 is a temporary local inside pairFor.
token1 is a temporary local inside pairFor.
pair is the return local of pairFor and collapses into the function.
i is the loop counter local of list and has no independent meaning.
notABot is the local result of the low-level call inside the checkBots modifier.
isNotBot is the unused local return data of the low-level call inside checkBots.
